dateline: BTS completed the scheduled three-night São Paulo run at Estádio MorumBIS (Oct 28, 30, 31) of the ARIRANG World Tour; only pre-show coverage has been verified, with no post-show reports yet.
heroHeadline: Day 4,889: BTS Wrap São Paulo Leg of ARIRANG World Tour
heroSubtitle: November 1, 2026 is Day 4,889 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The three-date São Paulo leg at Estádio MorumBIS (Oct 28, 30, 31) has ended on schedule; post-show details are still unverified.
